newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH SHARES FIRM 0.8 PCT BUT OFF HIGHS.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH SHARES FIRM 0.8 PCT BUT OFF HIGHS.

text.p: Istanbul shares firmed an average 0.81 percent in selective activity on Thursday, but afternoon profit-taking sparked by stiff resistance erased part of the early gains, brokers said.

The IMKB-100 closed up 522.3 points at 65,138.93, bringing three-day gains to 3.55 percent after Monday's 0.8 percent drop. It brushed a high of 65,790 in the day. Trade volume eased to 8.33 trillion lira from Wednesday's 8.91 trillion.

"It was again proven that resistance between 65,000-65,500 is a strong one. I think the three-day upward move which was fuelled by state shares has died down. Support is now awaited at 64,000," said Cenk Akyoldas from Yatirim Finansman securities.
A technical recovery had begun with the help of limited cash influx, after support of the index was confirmed at 62,500 on Monday.

The 85-share industrial index .ISEI firmed 0.48 percent to 71,563.79 and the 15-share financial index gained 1.68 percent to 57,481.63. Of the 218 shares traded, 103 advanced, 61 declined and 54 ended stable.

Top actives were again the shares of largely state-owned firms -- flat steel giant Eregli, up 300 lira at 9,400, petroleum refiner Tupras, up 250 lira at 15,000, petroleum distributor Petrol Ofisi, down 1,000 lira at 27,000 and Turkish Airlines, steady at 25,000 lira. -- Aydan Eksin, Istanbul newsroom +90-212-275 0875.
